gloss: opening of a port or airport

definitions.gloss: opening of a port or airport; opening to trade
definitions.explanation: The act of opening a port to foreign or domestic trade, or the historical event of a port being opened. Often refers to the opening of Japanese ports in the Bakumatsu period.

examples.japanese: ⟦{横浜|よこはま}→横浜：28138_yokohama⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧1859⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{開港|かいこう}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Yokohama opened as a port in 1859.

examples.japanese: {開港|かいこう}⟦{以来|いらい}→以来：01831_irai⟧、⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{貿易|ぼうえき}→貿易：01727_boueki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{栄|さか}えた→栄える：13104_sakaeru⟧。
examples.english: Since the port opened, this town prospered through trade.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{空港|くうこう}→空港：00648_kuukou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来年|らいねん}→来年：00745_rainen⟧{開港|かいこう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧だ。
examples.english: A new airport is scheduled to open next year.

notes:
Can also apply to airports (opening an airport for service). In Japanese history, {開港|かいこう} often refers to the forced opening of ports like ⟦{横浜|よこはま}→横浜：28138_yokohama⟧, ⟦{神戸|こうべ}→神戸：30710_koube⟧, ⟦{長崎|ながさき}→長崎：30731_nagasaki⟧, and {函館|はこだて} after the arrival of Perry's fleet.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {開港|かいこう}⟦{記念|きねん}{日|び}→記念日：05585_kinenbi⟧ (port opening anniversary)
- {開港|かいこう}⟦{都市|とし}→都市：01477_toshi⟧ (port city / treaty port)
- ⟦{強制|きょうせい}→強制：12500_kyousei⟧{開港|かいこう} (forced opening of a port)

The verb form {開港|かいこう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ means "to open a port" or "to begin operations" (for airports).
